beatitudes9.plain: Jesus ends with joy in hard times. When people misunderstand or hurt us because of our faith, He says to rejoice—our reward in heaven is great.
beatitudes9.today: Where has He been faithful to you through difficulty this week?
beatitudes9.action: Thank God for one way He has been with you through difficulty this week.
beatitudes9.prayer: Jesus, even when it's hard, I rejoice because You are worth it. Amen.

beatitudesKids9.title: When you feel small
beatitudesKids9.text: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
beatitudesKids9.speaker: Jesus on the mount
beatitudesKids9.plain: Jesus loves kids who know they need help. When you feel small or not good enough, that's when He opens the door to His big kingdom.
beatitudesKids9.today: Did anything make you feel small today?
beatitudesKids9.action: Quietly whisper to Jesus one thing that makes you feel small today.
beatitudesKids9.prayer: Jesus, I feel small sometimes. Thank You for Your big love. Amen.

beatitudesKids9.title: When you're sad
beatitudesKids9.text: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
beatitudesKids9.speaker: Jesus on the mount
beatitudesKids9.plain: It's okay to feel sad. Jesus sees every tear and wants to hug your heart with His comfort.
beatitudesKids9.today: What feels sad in your heart today?
beatitudesKids9.action: Draw a quick picture or whisper to Jesus about something that makes you sad.
beatitudesKids9.prayer: Jesus, when I'm sad, please hold my heart. Amen.

beatitudesKids9.title: Gentle like Jesus
beatitudesKids9.text: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
beatitudesKids9.speaker: Jesus on the mount
beatitudesKids9.plain: Being meek means being strong and gentle at the same time—like Jesus. Gentle wins in the end.
beatitudesKids9.today: Where could you choose gentle today?
beatitudesKids9.action: Do one small kind thing today, like sharing or helping with a smile.
beatitudesKids9.prayer: Jesus, make me gentle like You. Amen.

beatitudesKids9.title: Wanting what's right
beatitudesKids9.text: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.
beatitudesKids9.speaker: Jesus on the mount
beatitudesKids9.plain: When you really want to do what's right, Jesus promises to fill you up—like cool water on a hot day.
beatitudesKids9.today: What would "right" look like in one small moment today?
beatitudesKids9.action: Ask Jesus for one easy way to choose what's right today.
beatitudesKids9.prayer: Jesus, give me a heart that wants what's right. Fill me up. Amen.

beatitudesKids9.title: Being kind when it's hard
beatitudesKids9.text: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.
beatitudesKids9.speaker: Jesus on the mount
beatitudesKids9.plain: Mercy means being kind even when someone doesn't deserve it. When we show mercy, God shows us even more.
beatitudesKids9.today: Who could use a little kindness today?
beatitudesKids9.action: Do one quiet kind thing today—maybe a smile or sharing a toy.
beatitudesKids9.prayer: Lord, help me be kind like You are kind to me. Amen.

beatitudesKids9.title: A clean heart
beatitudesKids9.text: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.
beatitudesKids9.speaker: Jesus on the mount
beatitudesKids9.plain: A pure heart wants God more than anything else. Jesus helps clean our hearts so we can see Him better.
beatitudesKids9.today: What thought could you hand to Him for one minute?
beatitudesKids9.action: Sit quietly for one minute and ask Jesus to make your thoughts happy and clean.
beatitudesKids9.prayer: Jesus, make my heart clean so I can see You. Amen.

beatitudesKids9.title: Making peace
beatitudesKids9.text: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.
beatitudesKids9.speaker: Jesus on the mount
beatitudesKids9.plain: Peacemakers bring calm when things feel stormy. When we choose peace, we look like God's kids.
beatitudesKids9.today: Where could peace start with your voice today?
beatitudesKids9.action: Use a soft voice or kind words in one moment today—maybe during play or at home.
beatitudesKids9.prayer: Father, make me a peacemaker so others see You in me. Amen.

beatitudesKids9.title: When it's hard to do right
beatitudesKids9.text: Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness' sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
beatitudesKids9.speaker: Jesus on the mount
beatitudesKids9.plain: Sometimes doing the right thing feels hard or others don't understand. Jesus says even then we are blessed.
beatitudesKids9.today: Is anything hard about doing right today?
beatitudesKids9.action: If something feels hard today, remember Jesus is right there with you.
beatitudesKids9.prayer: Jesus, when it's hard to do right, help me remember Your kingdom is mine. Amen.

beatitudesKids9.title: Be glad anyway
beatitudesKids9.text: Blessed are ye, when men shall revile you, and persecute you, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake. Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.
beatitudesKids9.speaker: Jesus on the mount
beatitudesKids9.plain: Even when people are mean because we love Jesus, He says to be glad—our reward in heaven is huge.
beatitudesKids9.today: What is one good or fun thing from this week?
beatitudesKids9.action: Thank Jesus for one fun or good thing that happened this week.
beatitudesKids9.prayer: Jesus, even when it's hard, I'm glad because You are with me. Amen.

lettingGo7.title: Root of bitterness
lettingGo7.text: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and thereby many be defiled;
lettingGo7.speaker: The writer of Hebrews
lettingGo7.plain: Bitterness does not stay private—it springs up and defiles more than you.
lettingGo7.today: Is there a root you have been nursing instead of digging out?
lettingGo7.action: Write one name or situation you will stop rehearsing aloud today.
lettingGo7.prayer: Lord, no root of bitterness. Trouble us no more with it. Amen.

lettingGo7.title: Lay aside every weight
lettingGo7.text: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,
lettingGo7.speaker: The writer of Hebrews
lettingGo7.plain: Bitterness is weight. Drop it so you can run.
lettingGo7.today: What weight has bitterness added to your chest?
lettingGo7.action: Physically open your hands once and whisper: "I lay it down."
lettingGo7.prayer: Father, I lay aside this weight. Let me run. Amen.

lettingGo7.title: Forgive men their trespasses
lettingGo7.text: For if ye forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you: But if ye forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
lettingGo7.speaker: Jesus — in the Sermon on the Mount
lettingGo7.plain: Forgiving others is tied to receiving forgiveness—Jesus does not leave that vague.
lettingGo7.today: Who are you refusing to forgive while still wanting mercy yourself?
lettingGo7.action: Pray one sentence: "I forgive ______ as I need mercy."
lettingGo7.prayer: Father, I forgive. Forgive me. Amen.

lettingGo7.title: Avenge not yourselves
lettingGo7.text: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.
lettingGo7.speaker: Paul
lettingGo7.plain: Letting go means giving the payback line to God.
lettingGo7.today: What vengeance fantasy have you replayed?
lettingGo7.action: Say: "Vengeance is Yours." Leave the room if you need to.
lettingGo7.prayer: Lord, I give place to Your wrath, not mine. Repay in Your way. Amen.

lettingGo7.title: Forbearing and forgiving
lettingGo7.text: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.
lettingGo7.speaker: Paul
lettingGo7.plain: Christ is the measure—not how much they deserve.
lettingGo7.today: What quarrel are you carrying that needs forbearing today?
lettingGo7.action: Send a short, kind text—or decide not to send the sharp one you drafted.
lettingGo7.prayer: Jesus, You forgave me. Help me forgive as You did. Amen.

lettingGo7.title: Cover a transgression
lettingGo7.text: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; but he that repeateth a matter separateth very friends.
lettingGo7.speaker: Solomon
lettingGo7.plain: Love covers; gossip and grudge-stoking separate.
lettingGo7.today: What matter have you repeated that you could cover in love?
lettingGo7.action: Refuse one repeat today—do not tell that story again.
lettingGo7.prayer: Lord, I seek love; I cover what love should cover. Amen.

lettingGo7.title: Tenderhearted, forgiving one another
lettingGo7.text: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.
lettingGo7.speaker: Paul
lettingGo7.plain: Tender heart—not calloused by bitterness. Forgive as God forgave you.
lettingGo7.today: After seven days, what feels softer—and what still needs God?
lettingGo7.action: Thank God for one way He forgave you. Pass it forward in one act.
lettingGo7.prayer: Father, tender heart. I forgive as You forgave me. Amen.

lordsPrayer7.title: Our Father
lordsPrayer7.text: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven,
lordsPrayer7.speaker: Jesus teaching His disciples to pray
lordsPrayer7.plain: Jesus begins by calling God "Our Father." He is close, caring, and wants us to come to Him like children coming home.
lordsPrayer7.today: Do you feel welcome to come to Him today?
lordsPrayer7.action: Quietly say "Our Father" and picture God smiling at you.
lordsPrayer7.prayer: Our Father in heaven, thank You for being my loving Father. Amen.

lordsPrayer7.title: Hallowed be thy name
lordsPrayer7.speaker: Jesus teaching His disciples to pray
lordsPrayer7.plain: We pause to honor God's holy and beautiful name. Starting with praise reminds us who He is.
lordsPrayer7.today: What about Him feels beautiful or strong to you?
lordsPrayer7.action: Tell God one thing you love about who He is today.
lordsPrayer7.prayer: Hallowed be Thy name. You are holy and wonderful. Amen.

lordsPrayer7.title: Thy kingdom come
lordsPrayer7.text: Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.
lordsPrayer7.speaker: Jesus teaching His disciples to pray
lordsPrayer7.plain: We ask for God's good and peaceful ways to happen here, just as they do perfectly in heaven.
lordsPrayer7.today: What part of your heart wants His peace today?
lordsPrayer7.action: Pray for God's will in one quiet part of your day.
lordsPrayer7.prayer: Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done. Amen.

lordsPrayer7.title: Daily bread
lordsPrayer7.text: Give us this day our daily bread.
lordsPrayer7.speaker: Jesus teaching His disciples to pray
lordsPrayer7.plain: Jesus teaches us to ask for what we need today. God cares about our everyday needs.
lordsPrayer7.today: What do you need Him to carry for today only?
lordsPrayer7.action: Thank God for one thing He has already given you today.
lordsPrayer7.prayer: Give us this day our daily bread. Thank You for taking care of me. Amen.

lordsPrayer7.title: Forgiveness
lordsPrayer7.text: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.
lordsPrayer7.speaker: Jesus teaching His disciples to pray
lordsPrayer7.plain: We ask God to forgive us, and we choose to forgive others. This keeps our hearts light and free.
lordsPrayer7.today: What would lighten your heart to release today?
lordsPrayer7.action: Quietly forgive one small hurt and ask God to forgive you.
lordsPrayer7.prayer: Forgive us our debts, as we forgive others. Amen.

lordsPrayer7.title: Lead us not into temptation
lordsPrayer7.text: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil.
lordsPrayer7.speaker: Jesus teaching His disciples to pray
lordsPrayer7.plain: We ask God to protect us from wrong choices and from anything that pulls us away from Him.
lordsPrayer7.today: Where do you want His help to choose well?
lordsPrayer7.action: Ask God to help you make one good choice today.
lordsPrayer7.prayer: Lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.

lordsPrayer7.title: The kingdom, power, and glory
lordsPrayer7.text: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.
lordsPrayer7.speaker: Jesus teaching His disciples to pray
lordsPrayer7.plain: We end by remembering everything belongs to God—the kingdom, the power, and all the glory—forever.
lordsPrayer7.today: What about Him do you want to thank Him for tonight?
lordsPrayer7.action: Praise God for one big thing about Him before you finish the day.
lordsPrayer7.prayer: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.

lordsPrayerKids7.title: Our Father
lordsPrayerKids7.text: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven,
lordsPrayerKids7.speaker: Jesus teaching His disciples to pray
lordsPrayerKids7.plain: Jesus starts by calling God "Our Father." That means God is close and loves us the way a good father loves his children.
lordsPrayerKids7.today: Does it feel good to know God is your Father?
lordsPrayerKids7.action: Quietly say "Our Father" and smile because God is glad to hear from you.
lordsPrayerKids7.prayer: Our Father in heaven, thank You for loving me like a good Father. Amen.

lordsPrayerKids7.title: Hallowed be thy name
lordsPrayerKids7.speaker: Jesus teaching His disciples to pray
lordsPrayerKids7.plain: We tell God His name is special and holy. It is like saying "You are wonderful!"
lordsPrayerKids7.today: What about God feels wonderful to you today?
lordsPrayerKids7.action: Tell God one thing you think is wonderful about Him.
lordsPrayerKids7.prayer: Hallowed be Thy name. You are wonderful, God. Amen.

lordsPrayerKids7.title: Thy kingdom come
lordsPrayerKids7.text: Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.
lordsPrayerKids7.speaker: Jesus teaching His disciples to pray
lordsPrayerKids7.plain: We ask for God's good and kind ways to happen here, just like they do in heaven.
lordsPrayerKids7.today: Where could God's kindness show up today?
lordsPrayerKids7.action: Pray for God's kindness in one part of your day—at home, school, or play.
lordsPrayerKids7.prayer: Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done. Amen.

lordsPrayerKids7.title: Daily bread
lordsPrayerKids7.text: Give us this day our daily bread.
lordsPrayerKids7.speaker: Jesus teaching His disciples to pray
lordsPrayerKids7.plain: We ask God to take care of what we need today—food, help, or a peaceful heart.
lordsPrayerKids7.today: What good gift has He already given you today?
lordsPrayerKids7.action: Thank God for one thing He gave you today, like food or a friend.
lordsPrayerKids7.prayer: Give us this day our daily bread. Thank You for taking care of me. Amen.

lordsPrayerKids7.title: Forgiveness
lordsPrayerKids7.text: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.
lordsPrayerKids7.speaker: Jesus teaching His disciples to pray
lordsPrayerKids7.plain: We ask God to forgive us when we mess up, and we choose to forgive others too.
lordsPrayerKids7.today: What small hurt could you hand to Him today?
lordsPrayerKids7.action: Quietly forgive one small thing and ask God to forgive you.
lordsPrayerKids7.prayer: Forgive us when we do wrong, as we forgive others. Amen.

lordsPrayerKids7.title: Keep us safe
lordsPrayerKids7.text: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil.
lordsPrayerKids7.speaker: Jesus teaching His disciples to pray
lordsPrayerKids7.plain: We ask God to help us make good choices and keep us safe from anything that would pull us away from Him.
lordsPrayerKids7.today: Where do you want help to choose well?
lordsPrayerKids7.action: Ask God to help you make one good choice today.
lordsPrayerKids7.prayer: Keep me safe and help me choose what's right. Amen.

lordsPrayerKids7.title: God is the greatest
lordsPrayerKids7.text: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.
lordsPrayerKids7.speaker: Jesus teaching His disciples to pray
lordsPrayerKids7.plain: We end by remembering God has the greatest kingdom, all power, and all the glory—forever.
lordsPrayerKids7.today: What big thing do you love about God tonight?
lordsPrayerKids7.action: Tell God one big thing you like about Him before you go to sleep.
lordsPrayerKids7.prayer: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.

fearNot14.title: Fear thou not
fearNot14.text: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
fearNot14.speaker: God to a frightened people
fearNot14.plain: Four "I wills." He is with you—not watching from far off.
fearNot14.today: What are you afraid of that His hand could uphold today?
fearNot14.action: Say the five "I will" phrases from God slowly.
fearNot14.prayer: I will not fear; You are with me. Uphold me. Amen.

fearNot14.title: I have redeemed thee
fearNot14.text: But now thus saith the LORD that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.
fearNot14.speaker: God through Isaiah
fearNot14.today: Do you live as if you belong to Him—or only to your anxiety?
fearNot14.prayer: Lord, I am Yours. Fear not. Amen.

fearNot14.title: More value than sparrows
fearNot14.text: Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.
fearNot14.speaker: Jesus
fearNot14.plain: Anxiety shrinks your worth; Jesus names your value.
fearNot14.today: What lie says you do not matter?
fearNot14.action: Thank Him for one way He has cared for you lately.
fearNot14.prayer: Father, I am of more value than many sparrows. Thank You. Amen.

fearNot14.title: Fear not, little flock
fearNot14.text: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the kingdom.
fearNot14.speaker: Jesus
fearNot14.plain: Small and scared is still a flock He delights to give the kingdom.
fearNot14.today: What fear about the future stole sleep this week?
fearNot14.action: Read this verse before bed tonight.
fearNot14.prayer: Good Father, it pleases You to give us the kingdom. Amen.

fearNot14.title: Let not your heart be troubled
fearNot14.text: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.
fearNot14.speaker: Jesus — the night before the cross
fearNot14.plain: Trouble in the heart is addressed with trust—not denial.
fearNot14.today: What trouble are you carrying that belongs in "believe also in me"?
fearNot14.action: Write "believe also in me" on paper; carry it today.
fearNot14.prayer: Jesus, I believe in God; I believe also in You. Quiet my heart. Amen.

fearNot14.title: I will fear no evil
fearNot14.text: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.
fearNot14.speaker: David
fearNot14.plain: The valley is real; so is His with-you presence.
fearNot14.today: What valley name fits your week?
fearNot14.action: Walk one room slowly and say: "Thou art with me."
fearNot14.prayer: Lord, through the valley—I will fear no evil. Amen.

fearNot14.title: When I am afraid
fearNot14.text: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
fearNot14.speaker: David
fearNot14.plain: Afraid is not failure—trust is the next line.
fearNot14.today: What time today will you choose trust when fear spikes?
fearNot14.action: Set a two-minute alarm; when it rings, pray: "I trust in You."
fearNot14.prayer: When I am afraid, I will trust in You. Amen.

fearNot14.title: Not a spirit of fear
fearNot14.text: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
fearNot14.speaker: Paul to Timothy
fearNot14.plain: Fear as a ruling spirit is not His gift—power, love, sound mind are.
fearNot14.today: Which of the three do you need most today—power, love, or sound mind?
fearNot14.action: Name it and ask Him for it once an hour, three times.
fearNot14.prayer: Spirit of power, love, sound mind—replace fear's rule. Amen.

fearNot14.title: Perfect peace
fearNot14.text: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
fearNot14.speaker: Isaiah
fearNot14.plain: Stayed mind on Him—not on the headline.
fearNot14.today: What has your mind been fixed on instead of Him?
fearNot14.action: Five minutes: one verse, breathe, repeat His name.
fearNot14.prayer: Keep me in perfect peace; my mind stays on You. Amen.

fearNot14.title: Whom shall I fear?
fearNot14.text: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
fearNot14.speaker: David
fearNot14.plain: Light, salvation, strength—fear loses its audience.
fearNot14.today: Who or what have you been afraid of that shrinks next to "my light"?
fearNot14.action: Say aloud: "The LORD is my light and my salvation."
fearNot14.prayer: Lord, my light and salvation—whom shall I fear? Amen.

fearNot14.title: Fear of man
fearNot14.text: The fear of man bringeth a snare: but whoso putteth his trust in the LORD shall be safe.
fearNot14.speaker: Solomon
fearNot14.plain: People-pleasing and fear of opinion trap you; trust in the LORD is safe.
fearNot14.today: Where is fear of man steering you?
fearNot14.action: Decline one fear-of-man choice today—small but honest.
fearNot14.prayer: I put trust in the LORD; I refuse the snare. Amen.

fearNot14.title: He will not fail thee
fearNot14.text: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the LORD thy God, he it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
fearNot14.speaker: Moses to Israel
fearNot14.plain: He goes with you; failure and forsaking are not His way.
fearNot14.action: Text yourself: "He will not fail thee nor forsake thee."
fearNot14.prayer: Lord, strong and courageous—I fear not; You go with me. Amen.

fearNot14.title: He will rejoice over thee
fearNot14.text: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.
fearNot14.speaker: Zephaniah
fearNot14.plain: God sings over you—fear is not the loudest voice in His house.
fearNot14.today: When did you last let "He joys over me" land?
fearNot14.action: Play or hum one hymn; imagine Him singing over you.
fearNot14.prayer: Mighty God in my midst, rejoice over me; I listen. Amen.

fearNot14.title: Fear not; I am the first and the last
fearNot14.text: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying unto me, Fear not; I am the first and the last:
fearNot14.speaker: John — before the risen Christ in glory
fearNot14.plain: The first and the last touches you and says fear not—fourteen days end here.
fearNot14.today: What fear still knocks—and will you answer it with His touch?
fearNot14.action: Write one line: "Fear not, for He is first and last."
fearNot14.prayer: Jesus, first and last—fear not. I rest in You. Amen.

workLabor7.title: Heartily as to the Lord
workLabor7.text: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men; Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve the Lord Christ.
workLabor7.speaker: Paul — bondservants and free hearts
workLabor7.plain: Your real boss is Christ—Monday through Saturday, not only Sunday.
workLabor7.today: What task feels "only unto men"—and how would you do it for Him?
workLabor7.action: Do one job today with whispered: "As to the Lord."
workLabor7.prayer: Lord Christ, I serve You in this work. Amen.

workLabor7.title: Commit thy works
workLabor7.text: Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.
workLabor7.speaker: Solomon
workLabor7.plain: Hand your labor to Him first—clarity follows surrender.
workLabor7.today: What project needs committing before striving?
workLabor7.action: Pray over one work matter before you open email or tools.
workLabor7.prayer: I commit my works to You; establish my thoughts. Amen.

workLabor7.title: Labour, working with hands
workLabor7.text: Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labour, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth.
workLabor7.speaker: Paul
workLabor7.plain: Honest work has dignity—and room to give.
workLabor7.today: How can your labor bless someone in need this week?
workLabor7.action: Set aside something small to give from today's wage or pantry.
workLabor7.prayer: Lord, let my hands work good and give. Amen.

workLabor7.title: Quiet life, own business
workLabor7.text: And that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you; That ye may walk honestly toward them that are without, and that ye may have lack of nothing.
workLabor7.speaker: Paul
workLabor7.plain: Ambition without quiet honesty makes noise; walk so outsiders respect Christ.
workLabor7.today: Where are you in someone else's business online or at work?
workLabor7.action: Practice one hour of minding your own business—literally.
workLabor7.prayer: Teach me quiet, honest labor. Amen.

workLabor7.title: Diligent in business
workLabor7.text: Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men.
workLabor7.speaker: Solomon
workLabor7.plain: Diligence opens doors—God often uses skill and faithfulness.
workLabor7.today: What skill will you sharpen this week—not for vanity, for faithfulness?
workLabor7.action: Give thirty focused minutes to one craft or task.
workLabor7.prayer: Make me diligent; I would stand before You first. Amen.

workLabor7.title: Whatsoever thy hand findeth
workLabor7.text: Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do it with thy might; for there is no work, nor device, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in the grave, whither thou goest.
workLabor7.speaker: The Preacher
workLabor7.plain: This day is the day to work with might—not endless tomorrow.
workLabor7.today: What have you postponed that your hand could do today?
workLabor7.action: Finish one deferred task before dinner.
workLabor7.prayer: Lord, with my might today—for You. Amen.

workLabor7.title: Seek ye first
workLabor7.text: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
workLabor7.speaker: Jesus
workLabor7.plain: Provision follows priority—kingdom first, not anxiety first.
workLabor7.today: What "these things" worry you—and will you seek Him first anyway?
workLabor7.action: Start tomorrow with five minutes Scripture before feeds.
workLabor7.prayer: Kingdom first, righteousness first—thank You for adding what I need. Amen.

christmas7.title: A child is born
christmas7.text: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.
christmas7.speaker: Isaiah — light in dark politics
christmas7.plain: The government on His shoulder—not on your panic.
christmas7.today: What worry about "who is in charge" needs His shoulder?
christmas7.action: Read the four names slowly; thank Him for one.
christmas7.prayer: Prince of Peace, govern my heart today. Amen.

christmas7.title: Good tidings of great joy
christmas7.text: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people. For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.
christmas7.speaker: The angel to shepherds
christmas7.today: Where do you feel too ordinary for God to notice?
christmas7.action: Tell one person "good tidings"—one true sentence about Jesus.
christmas7.prayer: Christ the Lord—great joy to all people, including me. Amen.

christmas7.title: The Word was made flesh
christmas7.text: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
christmas7.speaker: John
christmas7.plain: God moved into the neighborhood—grace and truth, not hype.
christmas7.today: Where do you need grace and truth together this week?
christmas7.action: Dwell on "full of grace and truth" five minutes.
christmas7.prayer: Word made flesh, dwell among us still. Amen.

christmas7.title: They shall call his name Emmanuel
christmas7.text: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us.
christmas7.speaker: Matthew — Isaiah's word fulfilled
christmas7.plain: God with us—not God far off.
christmas7.action: Say "Emmanuel" three times as a breath prayer.
christmas7.prayer: Emmanuel—God with us in this room. Amen.

christmas7.title: Thou shalt call his name JESUS
christmas7.text: And, behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son, and shalt call his name JESUS. He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest: and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David: And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end.
christmas7.speaker: The angel to Mary
christmas7.plain: His name means salvation; His kingdom has no end.
christmas7.today: What part of your life needs His reign without end?
christmas7.action: Pray the Lord's Prayer once, slowly, on "Thy kingdom come."
christmas7.prayer: Jesus, great Son of the Highest—reign in me. Amen.

christmas7.title: Out of thee shall he come forth
christmas7.text: But thou, Bethlehem Ephratah, though thou be little among the thousands of Judah, yet out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.
christmas7.speaker: Micah
christmas7.plain: Small places birth God's ruler—from everlasting.
christmas7.today: What "little" place in your life might He use?
christmas7.action: Thank God for one small kindness you saw today.
christmas7.prayer: Ruler in Israel—from everlasting—come forth in my little places. Amen.

christmas7.title: Grace hath appeared
christmas7.text: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men,
christmas7.speaker: Paul to Titus
christmas7.plain: Christmas is not a mood—it is appearing grace that saves.
christmas7.today: How will you carry this grace past the decorations?
christmas7.action: Read Titus 2:11-14; underline one phrase to keep.
christmas7.prayer: Grace that brings salvation—thank You for appearing. Amen.

newYear7.title: New every morning
newYear7.text: It is of the LORD'S mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
newYear7.speaker: Jeremiah — after honest grief
newYear7.plain: The year turns; His compassions turn fresh each dawn.
newYear7.today: What from last year still feels heavy—and can meet "new every morning"?
newYear7.action: Before sleep, thank Him for one mercy from today.
newYear7.prayer: Great is Thy faithfulness—new mercies tomorrow. Amen.

newYear7.title: Number our days
newYear7.text: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.
newYear7.speaker: Moses
newYear7.plain: Wisdom starts with counting days as finite gifts.
newYear7.today: If this year were twelve numbered chapters, what is chapter one for?
newYear7.action: Write three words for how you want to walk wisely this month.
newYear7.prayer: Teach me to number my days; give wisdom. Amen.

newYear7.title: Forgetting those things behind
newYear7.text: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before, I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
newYear7.speaker: Paul
newYear7.plain: Forget does not erase memory—it releases grip so you can press forward.
newYear7.action: Name it once to God; say "I reach forward."
newYear7.prayer: High calling of God in Christ—I press toward the mark. Amen.

newYear7.title: Behold, I will do a new thing
newYear7.text: Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old. Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
newYear7.speaker: God through Isaiah
newYear7.plain: He makes a way where you see only wasteland.
newYear7.today: What wilderness needs a river this year?
newYear7.action: Circle "a new thing" in your Bible or notes; pray it once.
newYear7.prayer: Do a new thing, Lord; spring forth. Amen.

newYear7.title: If the Lord will
newYear7.text: Go to now, ye that say, To day or to morrow we will go into such a city, and continue there a year, and buy and sell, and get gain: Whereas ye know not what shall be on the morrow. For what is your life? It is even a vapour, that appeareth for a little time, and then vanisheth away. For that ye ought to say, If the Lord will, we shall live, and do this, or that.
newYear7.speaker: James
newYear7.today: What plan needs "if the Lord will" humility?
newYear7.action: Add "Lord willing" to one calendar note or conversation.
newYear7.prayer: If You will, we live and do this. Amen.

newYear7.title: Blessed is the man
newYear7.text: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful. But his delight is in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night. And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.
newYear7.speaker: The psalmist
newYear7.plain: Year rhythm: meditating on His law—tree by water, fruit in season.
newYear7.today: Where do you walk, stand, or sit that needs shifting?
newYear7.action: Read five verses of Psalm 1 aloud.
newYear7.prayer: Plant me by Your water; let fruit come in season. Amen.

newYear7.title: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart
newYear7.text: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
newYear7.speaker: Solomon
newYear7.plain: The whole year fits here—trust, not your own read, acknowledge Him, He directs.
newYear7.today: What path needs His direction—not your map?
newYear7.action: Acknowledge Him aloud before one decision tomorrow.
newYear7.prayer: I trust with all my heart; direct my paths. Amen.

holySpirit7.title: Another Comforter
holySpirit7.text: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever; Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.
holySpirit7.speaker: Jesus — the night before the cross
holySpirit7.plain: The Spirit is a Person—not a force. Truth, abiding, forever.
holySpirit7.today: Do you relate to Him as real—or as background noise?
holySpirit7.action: Thank the Father once out loud for giving the Comforter.
holySpirit7.prayer: Holy Spirit of truth, abide with me. I want to know You. Amen.

holySpirit7.title: Guide you into truth
holySpirit7.text: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.
holySpirit7.speaker: Jesus — promising the Spirit
holySpirit7.plain: He guides; He does not freelance—He speaks what He hears from the Father.
holySpirit7.today: What decision needs "guide into truth" rather than your first impulse?
holySpirit7.action: Before one choice today, pause: "Spirit of truth, guide me."
holySpirit7.prayer: Spirit of truth, guide me into all truth. Amen.

holySpirit7.title: Spirit of God in you
holySpirit7.text: But ye are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of God dwell in you. Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ, he is none of his.
holySpirit7.speaker: Paul
holySpirit7.plain: If you belong to Christ, God's Spirit dwells in you—that is your new atmosphere.
holySpirit7.today: Where are you still living as if you were only "in the flesh"?
holySpirit7.action: Name one habit you will walk in the Spirit with today—not perfect, intentional.
holySpirit7.prayer: Spirit of God, I am Yours—dwell in me; I walk with You. Amen.

holySpirit7.title: Fruit of the Spirit
holySpirit7.text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
holySpirit7.speaker: Paul
holySpirit7.plain: Fruit grows from abiding—not from white-knuckling virtue lists.
holySpirit7.today: Which fruit is most lacking in your speech this week?
holySpirit7.action: Pick one fruit; pray for it before one hard conversation.
holySpirit7.prayer: Bear Your fruit in me—love, joy, peace—today. Amen.

holySpirit7.title: Manifestation of the Spirit
holySpirit7.text: Now there are diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit. And there are differences of administrations, but the same Lord. And there are diversities of operations, but it is the same God which worketh all in all. But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal.
holySpirit7.speaker: Paul
holySpirit7.plain: The Spirit shows up for the common good—not private show.
holySpirit7.today: How could your gift—or simple faithfulness—profit someone today?
holySpirit7.action: Serve one person with no spotlight—quiet profit.
holySpirit7.prayer: Same Spirit, same Lord—manifest through me for others. Amen.

holySpirit7.title: Walk in the Spirit
holySpirit7.text: This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.
holySpirit7.speaker: Paul
holySpirit7.plain: Walking is daily steps—not one heroic moment.
holySpirit7.today: What lust of the flesh is crouching at your door today?
holySpirit7.action: Take one literal walk or stretch; pray "I walk in the Spirit" three times.
holySpirit7.prayer: I walk in the Spirit; I will not fulfil the flesh. Amen.

holySpirit7.title: The Spirit helpeth
holySpirit7.text: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered. And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit, because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God.
holySpirit7.speaker: Paul
holySpirit7.plain: When words fail, the Spirit prays in you—according to God's will.
holySpirit7.today: What groaning have you held alone that belongs in His intercession?
holySpirit7.action: Groan one honest syllable to God—then be still ten seconds.
holySpirit7.prayer: Spirit, help my infirmities; pray in me according to God's will. Amen.

walkTheWord7.title: Be doers of the word
walkTheWord7.text: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
walkTheWord7.speaker: James
walkTheWord7.plain: Hearing without doing is self-deception—not harmless.
walkTheWord7.today: What sermon or verse have you heard repeatedly without obeying?
walkTheWord7.action: Do one concrete act that obeys yesterday's Scripture.
walkTheWord7.prayer: Lord, make me a doer—not a hearer only. Amen.

walkTheWord7.title: Heareth and doeth
walkTheWord7.text: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock:
walkTheWord7.speaker: Jesus — end of the Sermon on the Mount
walkTheWord7.plain: The wise life is built on hearing + doing—not admiration of Jesus' words.
walkTheWord7.today: What part of His sayings are you building on—and what is still sand?
walkTheWord7.prayer: Jesus, I hear and do—rock, not sand. Amen.

walkTheWord7.title: If ye love me, keep
walkTheWord7.text: If ye love me, keep my commandments.
walkTheWord7.speaker: Jesus
walkTheWord7.plain: Love shows up in obedience—not in feelings alone.
walkTheWord7.today: What command of Christ have you called love while ignoring?
walkTheWord7.action: Keep one command today on purpose—small, visible.
walkTheWord7.prayer: I love You; I keep Your commandments. Amen.

walkTheWord7.title: The word is nigh thee
walkTheWord7.text: But the word is very nigh unto thee, in thy mouth, and in thy heart, that thou mayest do it.
walkTheWord7.speaker: Moses — to Israel
walkTheWord7.plain: God's word is close enough to speak and live—not locked in heaven.
walkTheWord7.today: Is Scripture in your mouth and heart this week—or only on a shelf?
walkTheWord7.action: Speak one verse aloud before a meal.
walkTheWord7.prayer: Thy word in my mouth and heart—that I may do it. Amen.

walkTheWord7.title: Observe to do
walkTheWord7.text: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.
walkTheWord7.speaker: God to Joshua
walkTheWord7.plain: Meditation aims at doing—all that is written, not favorite verses only.
walkTheWord7.today: What part of the Book have you never "observed to do"?
walkTheWord7.action: Meditate five minutes on one chapter—end with one obedience step.
walkTheWord7.prayer: Book of the law in my mouth—help me observe to do. Amen.

walkTheWord7.title: Thy word have I hid
walkTheWord7.text: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.
walkTheWord7.speaker: The psalmist
walkTheWord7.plain: Hidden word is ammunition against sin—not decoration.
walkTheWord7.today: What sin pattern needs a verse hidden today?
walkTheWord7.action: Memorize one short verse—or write it on a card.
walkTheWord7.prayer: Thy word in my heart—that I might not sin against You. Amen.

walkTheWord7.title: Hear and keep
walkTheWord7.text: But he said, Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it.
walkTheWord7.speaker: Jesus
walkTheWord7.plain: Blessed is keeping—not only hearing impressive teaching.
walkTheWord7.today: After seven days, what will you keep this week?
walkTheWord7.action: Tell one person one thing you are keeping from Scripture.
walkTheWord7.prayer: Bless me to hear and keep Your word. Amen.

standFirm7.title: A way to escape
standFirm7.text: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.
standFirm7.speaker: Paul
standFirm7.plain: Temptation is not unique to you—and God caps the load and opens exits.
standFirm7.today: What temptation feels "only me"—and what escape might He have already placed?
standFirm7.action: Name the temptation; ask: "What is the way of escape today?"
standFirm7.prayer: Faithful God, show me the way to escape; I will bear it with You. Amen.

standFirm7.title: Flee youthful lusts
standFirm7.text: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
standFirm7.speaker: Paul to Timothy
standFirm7.plain: Sometimes wisdom is running—not debating the devil in the doorway.
standFirm7.today: What do you need to flee—not manage, not negotiate?
standFirm7.action: Delete, block, or walk away from one trigger today.
standFirm7.prayer: I flee youthful lusts; I follow righteousness and peace. Amen.

standFirm7.title: Resist the devil
standFirm7.text: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
standFirm7.speaker: James
standFirm7.today: Where have you resisted without submitting?
standFirm7.action: Submit one area aloud to God—then say "I resist you" to the temptation.
standFirm7.prayer: I submit to God; devil, flee. Amen.

standFirm7.title: Resist steadfast
standFirm7.text: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour: Whom resist stedfast in the faith, knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your brethren that are in the world.
standFirm7.speaker: Peter
standFirm7.plain: Your brothers and sisters fight too—you are not the only battlefield.
standFirm7.today: Who can you encourage in the faith this week—one text?
standFirm7.action: Send one "steadfast" encouragement to a believer.
standFirm7.prayer: Resist steadfast in the faith; the lion will not devour me. Amen.

standFirm7.title: Tempted yet without sin
standFirm7.text: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin.
standFirm7.speaker: The writer of Hebrews
standFirm7.plain: Jesus knows the pull—and never sinned. You can run to Him, not hide.
standFirm7.today: What infirmity does temptation exploit in you?
standFirm7.action: Pray Hebrews 4:16 next—boldly to the throne.
standFirm7.prayer: Jesus, tempted like me—without sin—have mercy. Amen.

standFirm7.title: Watch and pray
standFirm7.text: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
standFirm7.speaker: Jesus — in Gethsemane
standFirm7.plain: Willing spirit still needs watchful prayer—flesh is weak.
standFirm7.today: When does your flesh go weak every week—same hour, same app?
standFirm7.action: Set a prayer alarm for that window—two minutes.
standFirm7.prayer: Watch and pray with me; spare me from entering temptation. Amen.

standFirm7.title: Cleanse his way
standFirm7.text: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.
standFirm7.speaker: The psalmist
standFirm7.plain: Taking heed to God's word is how paths get clean—any age.
standFirm7.today: What part of your way needs cleansing—not managing image?
standFirm7.action: Read Psalm 119:9-11; pick one "heed" for tomorrow.
standFirm7.prayer: By Your word I cleanse my way. Amen.

greatCommission7.title: Teach all nations
greatCommission7.text: And Jesus came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth. Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.
greatCommission7.speaker: The risen Christ
greatCommission7.plain: His authority sends you; His presence goes with you—to the end.
greatCommission7.today: Who is your "nation"—neighbor, coworker, family—this month?
greatCommission7.action: Pray for one not-yet-believer by name.
greatCommission7.prayer: All power is Yours—go with me as I teach and love. Amen.

greatCommission7.title: Witnesses unto me
greatCommission7.text: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
greatCommission7.speaker: Jesus — before ascension
greatCommission7.today: What is your Jerusalem today—who is closest and not yet hearing?
greatCommission7.action: Speak one true sentence about Jesus to one person this week.
greatCommission7.prayer: Holy Ghost, empower me to be Your witness—starting here. Amen.

greatCommission7.title: Preach the gospel
greatCommission7.text: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
greatCommission7.speaker: The risen Lord
greatCommission7.plain: Every creature includes the clerk, the cousin, the quiet roommate.
greatCommission7.today: Who counts as "creature" you have avoided?
greatCommission7.action: Share gospel literature or a verse—or invite to church—one step.
greatCommission7.prayer: Send me; I will preach Christ. Amen.

greatCommission7.title: How shall they hear?
greatCommission7.text: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher? And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!
greatCommission7.speaker: Paul
greatCommission7.plain: Someone has to speak—feet go, mouth opens.
greatCommission7.today: Are you willing to be the one who opens mouth—however awkward?
greatCommission7.action: Practice one sentence gospel in the mirror once.
greatCommission7.prayer: Beautiful feet—use mine to bring good tidings. Amen.

greatCommission7.title: Salt and light
greatCommission7.text: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men. Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.
greatCommission7.speaker: Jesus — Sermon on the Mount
greatCommission7.plain: Salt and light are public—good works seen, Father glorified.
greatCommission7.today: Where has your salt lost savour—complaint, cynicism, silence?
greatCommission7.action: Do one good work in Jesus' name that someone will notice.
greatCommission7.prayer: Keep me salty and lit—Father glorified. Amen.

greatCommission7.title: Answer with meekness
greatCommission7.text: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:
greatCommission7.speaker: Peter
greatCommission7.plain: Hope shows; people ask; you answer gently—not winning debates.
greatCommission7.today: Who might ask if you looked more like hope?
greatCommission7.action: Write three lines: my hope is in ______ because ______.
greatCommission7.prayer: Sanctified heart—ready to answer with meekness. Amen.

greatCommission7.title: Beautiful upon the mountains
greatCommission7.text: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace; that bringeth good tidings of good, that publisheth salvation; that saith unto Zion, Thy God reigneth!
greatCommission7.speaker: Isaiah
greatCommission7.plain: Peace, salvation, God reigns—that is the message in your mouth.
greatCommission7.today: Seven days in—who heard good tidings from you?
greatCommission7.action: Thank God for one open door; ask for one more.
greatCommission7.prayer: Thy God reigneth—let my feet be beautiful with that news. Amen.

stewardship7.title: Godliness with contentment
stewardship7.text: But godliness with contentment is great gain. For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can carry nothing out. And having food and raiment let us therewith be content.
stewardship7.speaker: Paul to Timothy
stewardship7.plain: Gain is godliness + contentment—not bigger piles.
stewardship7.today: What are you chasing past "food and raiment" that steals peace?
stewardship7.action: Thank God for one thing you already have that counts as enough.
stewardship7.prayer: Godliness with contentment—great gain for me. Amen.

stewardship7.title: Ye cannot serve God and mammon
stewardship7.text: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.
stewardship7.speaker: Jesus
stewardship7.plain: Money as master competes with God—only one throne.
stewardship7.today: Where does money vote louder than Christ in your calendar?
stewardship7.action: Give firstfruits of today—time or money—before you spend.

stewardship7.title: Prove me herewith
stewardship7.text: Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse, that there may be meat in mine house, and prove me now herewith, saith the LORD of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there shall not be room enough to receive it.
stewardship7.speaker: God through Malachi
stewardship7.plain: Tithing is obedience with a test—God invites you to prove Him.
stewardship7.today: Is the storehouse fed—or only your comfort?
stewardship7.action: If you call a local church home, bring tithe this week faithfully.
stewardship7.prayer: Lord, I bring the tithe—open heaven as You will. Amen.

stewardship7.title: Cheerful giver
stewardship7.text: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.
stewardship7.speaker: Paul
stewardship7.plain: God cares about the heart in giving—not arm-twisted duty.
stewardship7.today: What gift have you given grudgingly—repent and re-give in spirit?
stewardship7.action: Give something small cheerfully today—secret if needed.
stewardship7.prayer: Make me a cheerful giver; You love that. Amen.

stewardship7.title: Honour the LORD with thy substance
stewardship7.text: Honour the LORD with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.
stewardship7.speaker: Solomon
stewardship7.plain: Firstfruits honor God before spreadsheets talk you out of it.
stewardship7.today: What increase came this month—and what firstfruit belongs to Him?
stewardship7.action: Set aside first portion before the rest is spent.
stewardship7.prayer: Honored with my substance and firstfruits. Amen.

stewardship7.title: Life consisteth not in abundance
stewardship7.text: And he said unto them, Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for a man's life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.
stewardship7.speaker: Jesus
stewardship7.plain: Your life is not your stockpile—guard against covetousness.
stewardship7.today: What possession story are you telling that shrinks your soul?
stewardship7.action: Unfollow one shop account or mute one envy trigger.
stewardship7.prayer: Life is more than abundance—free me from covetousness. Amen.

stewardship7.title: God shall supply
stewardship7.text: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
stewardship7.speaker: Paul
stewardship7.plain: Need—not every want—is supplied from glory-riches in Christ.
stewardship7.today: What need are you carrying as if God forgot?
stewardship7.action: List one need; pray "supply according to Your riches."
stewardship7.prayer: My God, supply our need—Your riches in glory by Christ Jesus. Amen.

moneyWorry7.title: Sufficient unto the day
moneyWorry7.text: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
moneyWorry7.speaker: Jesus — on the mount
moneyWorry7.plain: Tomorrow will borrow enough trouble on its own. Today is the only day you have to trust Him in.
moneyWorry7.today: What bill or number are you rehearsing past midnight—can you hand just today back to Him?
moneyWorry7.action: Write one money fear on paper; fold it; pray once: "This day is Yours."
moneyWorry7.prayer: Lord, enough for today. I will not borrow tomorrow's fear tonight. Amen.

moneyWorry7.title: Not seen the righteous forsaken
moneyWorry7.text: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.
moneyWorry7.speaker: The psalmist — a long witness
moneyWorry7.plain: This is not a promise of ease—it is a testimony across a whole life: God does not abandon His own.
moneyWorry7.today: When shame whispers you are on your own, whose testimony are you believing—the spreadsheet or the psalm?
moneyWorry7.action: Read Psalm 37:3-7 slowly once; underline one line to carry today.
moneyWorry7.prayer: Father, I feel forsaken sometimes anyway. Hold me to Your care. Amen.

moneyWorry7.title: Neither poverty nor riches
moneyWorry7.text: Remove far from me vanity and lies: give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with food convenient for me: Lest I be full, and deny thee, and say, Who is the LORD? or lest I be poor, and steal, and take the name of my God in vain.
moneyWorry7.speaker: Agur — an honest prayer
moneyWorry7.plain: The middle path here is dependence—enough to live, not enough to forget God, not so little that desperation dishonors Him.
moneyWorry7.today: Are you asking God only for "more"—or for "enough" with an upright heart?
moneyWorry7.action: Pray Agur's two verses aloud once; change nothing else for five minutes after.
moneyWorry7.prayer: Feed me with food convenient for me—keep my heart true. Amen.

moneyWorry7.title: Cast thy burden
moneyWorry7.text: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
moneyWorry7.speaker: David — overwhelmed
moneyWorry7.plain: Casting is not polite handing—it is throwing. The budget dread qualifies.
moneyWorry7.today: What weight are you still white-knuckling that belongs on His shoulders?
moneyWorry7.action: Name the burden out loud; say "Yours" once; leave the phone in another room ten minutes.
moneyWorry7.prayer: I cast this burden; sustain me. Amen.

moneyWorry7.title: Seek first
moneyWorry7.text: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
moneyWorry7.speaker: Jesus
moneyWorry7.plain: Order matters—His reign first; provision follows His way, not panic's way.
moneyWorry7.today: What did you seek first this morning—peace in numbers, or righteousness and His rule?
moneyWorry7.action: Before you open banking apps, read one verse and one sentence of prayer.
moneyWorry7.prayer: Kingdom first, Father—then trust You for these things. Amen.

moneyWorry7.title: Remember who gives power to get wealth
moneyWorry7.text: But thou shalt remember the LORD thy God: for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers, as it is this day.
moneyWorry7.speaker: Moses — warning and mercy
moneyWorry7.plain: Income is not proof you forgot God—unless you forget who gave the strength to work.
moneyWorry7.today: Can you thank Him for the ability to work—even if the job feels small?
moneyWorry7.action: Send one thank-you text to someone who helped you earn or learn—no money talk required.
moneyWorry7.prayer: You gave power to work; I remember You. Amen.

moneyWorry7.title: If riches increase
moneyWorry7.text: Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart upon them.
moneyWorry7.speaker: The psalmist
moneyWorry7.plain: Whether the balance went up or down—the heart must not anchor there.
moneyWorry7.today: After seven days, where is your heart leaning—toward calm trust or toward the account total?
moneyWorry7.action: Give or share something small today without calculating the return.
moneyWorry7.prayer: If riches increase, hold my heart on You—not on them. Amen.

addictionHope7.title: If we confess
addictionHope7.text: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
addictionHope7.speaker: John
addictionHope7.plain: Confession is not performance for a harsh judge—it is truth with a faithful Father who cleanses.
addictionHope7.today: What are you hiding that grows stronger in the dark?
addictionHope7.action: Confess one thing to God aloud—no excuses preface.
addictionHope7.prayer: Faithful God, forgive and cleanse me. I confess. Amen.

addictionHope7.title: No condemnation
addictionHope7.text: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
addictionHope7.speaker: Paul
addictionHope7.plain: Condemnation loops feed the relapse. In Christ, the verdict is already mercy—walk in step with the Spirit today.
addictionHope7.today: Whose voice is louder—the accuser or the Advocate?
addictionHope7.action: Write "no condemnation" on a card; read it when shame spikes.
addictionHope7.prayer: Thank You—no condemnation in Christ. Help me walk after the Spirit. Amen.

addictionHope7.title: A broken spirit
addictionHope7.text: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.
addictionHope7.speaker: David — after great failure
addictionHope7.plain: God does not want a polished story first—He wants honesty He can heal.
addictionHope7.today: Are you avoiding Him until you feel "fixed"?
addictionHope7.action: Sit five minutes with no phone—tell Him one true sentence about the struggle.
addictionHope7.prayer: A broken heart before You—You will not despise it. Amen.

addictionHope7.title: Who shall deliver me
addictionHope7.text: O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death? I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord.
addictionHope7.speaker: Paul — blunt and hopeful
addictionHope7.plain: The war inside is not proof you are fake—it is proof you need the Deliverer, not only willpower.
addictionHope7.today: Where does "I should" collapse into "I did it again"?
addictionHope7.action: Replace one self-lecture with "Thank God through Jesus Christ" once today.
addictionHope7.prayer: Deliver me, Lord—I thank You through Christ. Amen.

addictionHope7.title: Stand fast in liberty
addictionHope7.text: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.
addictionHope7.speaker: Paul
addictionHope7.plain: Freedom is a position in Christ—bondage often feels familiar; stand anyway.
addictionHope7.today: What old yoke are you picking back up because it feels known?
addictionHope7.action: Delete one easy access to the old pattern today—app, bookmark, or contact.
addictionHope7.prayer: I stand in Your liberty; keep me from the yoke. Amen.

addictionHope7.title: Confess and pray one for another
addictionHope7.text: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.
addictionHope7.speaker: James
addictionHope7.plain: Healing often walks through trusted human ears—not for shame, for shared prayer.
addictionHope7.today: Is isolation keeping the cycle alive?
addictionHope7.action: If you have a safe believer, ask for one short prayer this week—or use the site prayer wall anonymously.
addictionHope7.prayer: Heal what hiding broke; teach me honest prayer with others. Amen.

addictionHope7.title: New creature
addictionHope7.text: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.
addictionHope7.speaker: Paul
addictionHope7.plain: Your worst chapter is not the final word—Christ is making new.
addictionHope7.today: After seven days, what one "old thing" can you leave named at His feet?
addictionHope7.action: Thank God aloud for one small victory this week—even showing up.
addictionHope7.prayer: New creature in Christ—thank You for new. Amen.

caregiverRest7.title: Come and rest
caregiverRest7.text: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
caregiverRest7.speaker: Jesus
caregiverRest7.plain: Caregiving is holy labor—and it still counts as heavy laden. He invites you, not only the one in the bed.
caregiverRest7.today: When did someone last ask how you are—and did you tell the truth?
caregiverRest7.action: Lie down or sit still ten minutes; say "I am heavy laden" once to Him.
caregiverRest7.prayer: Jesus, I come—I need rest, not a medal. Amen.

caregiverRest7.title: Not weary in well doing
caregiverRest7.text: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
caregiverRest7.speaker: Paul
caregiverRest7.plain: Weariness is not failure—fainting is the risk; God promises a season of reaping.
caregiverRest7.today: What part of caregiving makes you want to quit today?
caregiverRest7.action: Do one kind thing for your own body today—water, food, shower—without guilt.
caregiverRest7.prayer: Steady me in well doing; I do not want to faint. Amen.

caregiverRest7.title: Power to the faint
caregiverRest7.text: He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.
caregiverRest7.speaker: Isaiah
caregiverRest7.plain: When you have no might left, He specializes in strength for the empty.
caregiverRest7.today: Where is your "no might"—sleep, patience, faith?
caregiverRest7.action: Text one word to a friend: "Pray"—no explanation required.
caregiverRest7.prayer: I am faint; give power. Amen.

caregiverRest7.title: Too heavy for thee alone
caregiverRest7.text: Thou wilt surely wear away, both thou, and this people that is with thee: for this thing is too heavy for thee; thou art not able to perform it thyself alone.
caregiverRest7.speaker: Jethro to Moses
caregiverRest7.plain: Even the best-hearted leader hits a limit—God sends wisdom through others.
caregiverRest7.today: What help have you refused because it felt like admitting defeat?
caregiverRest7.action: Accept or ask for one concrete help this week—meal, sitter, errand.
caregiverRest7.prayer: Save me from wearing away; send help I can receive. Amen.

caregiverRest7.title: Father of mercies
caregiverRest7.text: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort; Who comforteth us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.
caregiverRest7.speaker: Paul
caregiverRest7.plain: The comfort you need is the same stream you will someday pour for someone else—not yet perfectly, but truly.
caregiverRest7.today: Where do you need comfort—not advice?
caregiverRest7.action: Listen to one worship Psalm or hymn without multitasking.
caregiverRest7.prayer: God of all comfort, comfort me in this tribulation. Amen.

caregiverRest7.title: He giveth beloved sleep
caregiverRest7.text: It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep.
caregiverRest7.speaker: Solomon
caregiverRest7.plain: Bread of sorrows is real in caregiving—and He still gives sleep as gift, not wage.
caregiverRest7.today: What hour are you stealing from sleep to carry what is not yours tonight?
caregiverRest7.action: Set a phone bedtime alarm; obey it once this week.
caregiverRest7.prayer: Give Your beloved sleep; spare me vain striving. Amen.

caregiverRest7.title: Come apart and rest
caregiverRest7.text: And he said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
caregiverRest7.speaker: Jesus
caregiverRest7.plain: Jesus noticed "no leisure"—He commands rest, not only productivity.
caregiverRest7.today: When did you last eat without rushing?
caregiverRest7.action: Eat one meal seated, screen off, five deep breaths before the first bite.
caregiverRest7.prayer: You saw crowds; You see me. Help me rest a while. Amen.

teenFaith7.title: Say not, I am a child
teenFaith7.text: But say not, I am a child: for thou shalt go to all that I shall send thee, and whatsoever I command thee thou shalt speak.
teenFaith7.speaker: The LORD to Jeremiah
teenFaith7.plain: Youth is not disqualification—God sends and speaks through the willing.
teenFaith7.today: Where are you hiding behind "I'm just a kid" to avoid obedience?
teenFaith7.action: Speak one true kind sentence to someone at school or home today.
teenFaith7.prayer: Send me; I will speak what You command. Amen.

teenFaith7.title: Despise not thy youth
teenFaith7.text: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.
teenFaith7.speaker: Paul to Timothy
teenFaith7.plain: Example is how youth answers critics—speech, love, faith, purity.
teenFaith7.today: Which of those five feels weakest right now?
teenFaith7.action: Pick one—improve it in a small way today (apologize, encourage, step back from a feed).
teenFaith7.prayer: Make me an example—in word, love, faith, purity. Amen.

teenFaith7.title: Be not conformed
teenFaith7.text: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.
teenFaith7.speaker: Paul
teenFaith7.plain: Fitting the crowd is optional; renewed mind is how you know God's good will.
teenFaith7.today: What trend are you conforming to that shrinks your soul?
teenFaith7.action: Mute or unfollow one pressure source today.
teenFaith7.prayer: Transform my mind; I want Your will, not the world's mold. Amen.

teenFaith7.title: Cleanse his way
teenFaith7.text: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.
teenFaith7.speaker: The psalmist
teenFaith7.plain: Clean path is not charisma—it is attention to Scripture.
teenFaith7.today: What part of your week never meets God's word?
teenFaith7.action: Read five verses before bed tonight—any Psalm.
teenFaith7.prayer: By Your word I cleanse my way. Amen.

teenFaith7.title: Trust in the LORD
teenFaith7.text: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
teenFaith7.speaker: Solomon
teenFaith7.plain: Your understanding is loud; His direction comes when you acknowledge Him in all your ways.
teenFaith7.today: Where are you leaning on your own read of a situation?
teenFaith7.action: Pray "I acknowledge You in this" over one decision before you act.
teenFaith7.prayer: I trust You with all my heart; direct my paths. Amen.

teenFaith7.title: Let your light shine
teenFaith7.text: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
teenFaith7.speaker: Jesus
teenFaith7.plain: Good works are visibility with a purpose—Father glorified, not you performing.
teenFaith7.today: What good work can you do quietly that still honors God?
teenFaith7.action: Help one person without posting about it.
teenFaith7.prayer: Let my light shine for Your glory. Amen.

teenFaith7.title: He which hath begun
teenFaith7.text: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:
teenFaith7.speaker: Paul
teenFaith7.plain: School years feel endless—God's work in you is already underway and He finishes what He starts.
teenFaith7.today: What good work do you doubt He is doing in you?
teenFaith7.action: Write one line: "God began ______ in me."
teenFaith7.prayer: Perform Your good work in me until Christ's day. Amen.

peacemakers7.title: Called to be peacemakers
peacemakers7.text: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.
peacemakers7.speaker: Jesus on the mount
peacemakers7.plain: Jesus doesn't say "peace-lovers"—He says peacemakers. We are invited to actively bring His calm into the world around us.
peacemakers7.today: Where do you want His peace to land today?
peacemakers7.action: Pray one quiet prayer for peace in your home or school today.
peacemakers7.prayer: Father, make me a peacemaker so others see You in me. Amen.

peacemakers7.title: Peace starts inside
peacemakers7.text: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
peacemakers7.speaker: Jesus — the night before the cross
peacemakers7.plain: Before we can bring peace to others, we receive it from Jesus. His peace stays even when everything else feels loud.
peacemakers7.today: What is loud or troubled in your heart today?
peacemakers7.action: Sit still for one minute and breathe slowly while saying "Jesus, Your peace is mine."
peacemakers7.prayer: Jesus, fill my heart with Your peace today. Amen.

peacemakers7.title: Soft words
peacemakers7.text: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.
peacemakers7.speaker: Solomon
peacemakers7.plain: Sometimes the most powerful thing we can do is speak gently instead of sharply.
peacemakers7.today: Where could a softer answer change the temperature?
peacemakers7.action: Choose one moment today to answer with a softer tone or kinder word.
peacemakers7.prayer: Lord, help my words bring calm instead of chaos. Amen.

peacemakers7.title: Listening first
peacemakers7.text: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:
peacemakers7.speaker: James
peacemakers7.plain: Peacemakers listen more than they talk. When we truly hear someone, arguments often lose their power.
peacemakers7.today: Who needs to be heard before you respond?
peacemakers7.action: Practice listening to one person today without interrupting.
peacemakers7.prayer: Jesus, teach me to listen the way You do. Amen.

peacemakers7.title: Forgiving quickly
peacemakers7.text: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.
peacemakers7.speaker: Paul
peacemakers7.plain: Holding onto hurt keeps storms alive. Quick forgiveness brings peace.
peacemakers7.today: What hurt are you carrying that could be quietly released?
peacemakers7.action: Quietly forgive one small hurt today—even if the other person doesn't know.
peacemakers7.prayer: Lord, help me forgive quickly the way You forgive me. Amen.

peacemakers7.title: Praying for the other side
peacemakers7.text: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;
peacemakers7.speaker: Jesus on the mount
peacemakers7.plain: The hardest peacemaking happens when someone has hurt us. Praying for them changes hearts.
peacemakers7.today: Who is difficult to pray for with honesty?
peacemakers7.action: Pray one honest sentence for someone who is difficult right now.
peacemakers7.prayer: Father, bless the person who is hard for me to love. Amen.

peacemakers7.title: Children of God
peacemakers7.text: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.
peacemakers7.speaker: Jesus on the mount
peacemakers7.plain: When we choose peace, people see the family resemblance—we look like our heavenly Father.
peacemakers7.today: Where did God help you bring peace this week?
peacemakers7.action: Thank God for one way He helped you bring peace this week.
peacemakers7.prayer: Thank You for calling me Your child. Help me live like it every day. Amen.

sower7.title: The story Jesus told
sower7.text: And he spake many things unto them in parables, saying, Behold, a sower went forth to sow;
sower7.speaker: Jesus by the sea
sower7.plain: Jesus told this story to crowds of everyday people. A farmer scatters seed on four kinds of ground. The seed is God's Word—the good news of His kingdom.
sower7.today: When did you last slow down to hear a story from Jesus?
sower7.action: Read the parable quietly once today (Matthew 13:3-9).
sower7.prayer: Jesus, help me hear Your Word with an open heart. Amen.

sower7.title: The path
sower7.text: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.
sower7.speaker: Jesus explaining the parable
sower7.plain: Some seed falls on the hard path. The ground is packed down, so the seed cannot sink in. The enemy quickly snatches it away.
sower7.today: Where does God's Word bounce off instead of sinking in?
sower7.action: Ask God to soften any hard places in your heart today.
sower7.prayer: Lord, soften my heart so Your Word can take root. Amen.

sower7.title: Stony places
sower7.text: But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that heareth the word, and anon with joy receiveth it; Yet hath he not root in himself, but dureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, by and by he is offended.
sower7.speaker: Jesus explaining the parable
sower7.plain: Some seed falls on rocky ground with little soil. It springs up fast with joy, but when trouble comes it withers—roots are shallow.
sower7.today: What trouble has tested your joy lately?
sower7.action: Pray for deeper roots in God's Word when things get hard.
sower7.prayer: Jesus, give me deep roots so I can stand strong. Amen.

sower7.title: Among thorns
sower7.text: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that heareth the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.
sower7.speaker: Jesus explaining the parable
sower7.plain: Some seed falls among thorns. Worries and the pull of money grow up and choke the good seed so it cannot bear fruit.
sower7.today: What worry or distraction has been loudest?
sower7.action: Name one worry or distraction and quietly give it to God.
sower7.prayer: Father, clear away the thorns so Your Word can grow in me. Amen.

sower7.title: Good ground
sower7.text: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, and understandeth it; which also beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.
sower7.speaker: Jesus explaining the parable
sower7.plain: Some seed falls into good soil. It hears, understands, and bears fruit—thirty, sixty, or a hundred times what was sown.
sower7.today: Where have you seen God's Word bear fruit in your life?
sower7.action: Thank God for one way His Word has already helped you grow.
sower7.prayer: Lord, make my heart good soil that bears fruit for You. Amen.

sower7.title: The sower's generosity
sower7.text: And he spake many things unto them in parables, saying, Behold, a sower went forth to sow;
sower7.speaker: Jesus by the sea
sower7.plain: The farmer scatters seed generously—even toward ground that looks unpromising. Jesus keeps offering His Word to every heart with patience and love.
sower7.today: Where have you seen His patience toward you?
sower7.action: Remember that God is patient and generous with you today.
sower7.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for scattering Your Word so freely in my life. Amen.

sower7.title: Which soil am I?
sower7.text: Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
sower7.speaker: Jesus closing the parable
sower7.plain: Jesus ends with a gentle invitation: "Who hath ears to hear, let him hear." The story invites us to look at our hearts and ask God to make them good soil.
sower7.today: What kind of soil feels closest to your heart today?
sower7.action: Quietly ask God which kind of soil best describes your heart right now, and invite Him to help.
sower7.prayer: Jesus, help my heart receive Your Word and bear good fruit. Amen.

sowerKids7.title: Jesus' farmer story
sowerKids7.text: And he spake many things unto them in parables, saying, Behold, a sower went forth to sow;
sowerKids7.speaker: Jesus by the sea
sowerKids7.plain: Jesus told a story beside the water. A farmer tossed seed everywhere. The seed is like God's Word—truth He wants your heart to keep.
sowerKids7.today: What is one Bible story you remember?
sowerKids7.action: Ask someone you love to read Matthew 13:3-9 with you today—or listen quietly while they read.
sowerKids7.prayer: Jesus, help me hear Your Word with an open heart. Amen.
